# Zach Garner AI

> AI engineering, infrastructure, and technical leadership.

Zach Garner is an AI engineer and consultant based in St. Petersburg, Florida. Two decades of experience spanning machine learning, computer vision, autonomous agents, and production systems.

## Experience

- Currently at Anyscale (the company behind Ray) as a field engineer and solution architect - presales and postsales AI infrastructure
- Senior and principal engineering roles building ML platforms, computer vision pipelines, and data infrastructure at scale
- Technical leadership across research, production infrastructure, and customer-facing delivery

## Current Work

AI consulting - architecture, engineering, and strategy. Focused on agent systems, LLM infrastructure, and helping teams move from prototype to production.

## Other Ventures

- Cognizant Coaching (cognizantcoaching.com) - coaching for high-achieving, analytical, and neurodivergent people
- Zachariah Garner Photography (zachariahgarner.com) - fine art landscape and documentary photography
- Zaiah Ventures (zaiahventures.com) - parent holding company
